reason: At base revision, dayjs format('Y') falls through to timezone-offset fallback instead of outputting literal 'Y'. PR #3015 fixes this by making unsupported year tokens preserve literally.
At head revision, the refactored tryDecodeURIComponent still correctly decodes percent-encoded route parameters. The PR is a perf refactor that preserves behavior.
At base revision, Sidekiq job reschedule does not update the in-memory SortedEntry's score. PR fixes this by keeping in-memory score in sync after reschedule.
At head revision, the refactored tryDecodeURIComponent still correctly decodes percent-encoded route parameters. Behavior preserved from base.
At base revision, keeping SortedEntry's in-memory score in sync after reschedule is not implemented. PR adds this fix.
At head revision, the PR keeps SortedEntry's in-memory score in sync after reschedule, so the test's expected behavior holds.
At base revision, Content-Type header charset parsing (text/plain; charset=UTF-8) is standard HTTP behavior. PR is about Range header whitespace — unrelated, so base behavior holds.
At head revision, same unrelated PR, Content-Type charset parsing still works.
At base revision, Composer zip archiving preserving file modification timestamps is standard behavior. PR is about logging failed download URLs — unrelated.
At head revision, same unrelated PR, zip timestamp preservation still holds.
At base revision, async JSON deserialization with nullable parent property is standard System.Text.Json behavior. PR is about CredentialCache prefix comparison — unrelated.
At head revision, same unrelated PR, async deserialization still works.
At base revision, CockroachDB INET '192.168.1.5' <<= ANY (SELECT INET '192.168.1.0/24') is standard SQL. PR is about FETCH FIRST cursor — unrelated.
At head revision, same unrelated PR, INET <<= ANY comparison still works.
At base revision, NO_PROXY='::1' (IPv6 loopback) is not supported. PR #2660 adds IPv4/IPv6/localhost support. Client construction would fail without the fix.
At head revision, PR #2660 adds NO_PROXY support for ::1 IPv6 loopback, so client construction succeeds.
At base revision, Series.str.match raises NotImplementedError for regex flags other than re.I. The 'dot matches newline' (re.DOTALL) flag is not re.I, so the test fails. PR fixes the bug.
At head revision, PR fixes the regex flag validation bug, so dot-all matching works correctly.
At base revision, recursive result parents on group in middle of chain causes serialization to lose task results. PR fixes this specific issue.
At head revision, PR fixes recursive result parents, so chain serialization preserves all task results.
At base revision, value_terminator having no effect when first argument affects how trailing -- is handled by the CLI. The test's trailing '-- --check' depends on correct value_terminator behavior.
At head revision, PR fixes value_terminator so trailing -- handoff works correctly.
At base revision, late-arriving OSC11 response triggers OptionSet event incorrectly. PR fixes by using :noautocmd to suppress the event.
At head revision, PR fixes the late-arriving OSC11 OptionSet issue, so autocommands fire correctly.

At base revision, required field validation flagging a changeset invalid when a mandatory field is omitted is standard Elixir changeset behavior. PR is about compile-time dependencies in @derive — unrelated.
At head revision, same unrelated PR, required field validation still works correctly.
